name: Aerosmith

whyMatters.en: Boston blues-hard-rock five: Dream On (1973) ballad dynamics and Walk This Way (1975) riff/funk pocket set US hard-rock radio grammar; 1980s Run-DMC crossover and Crazy (1993) extend the catalog into MTV.
whyMatters.zh: 波士顿蓝调 hard-rock 五人组：Dream On（1973）谣曲动态与 Walk This Way（1975）riff/funk 口袋拍定美国 hard-rock 电台语法；80 年代 Run-DMC 跨界与 Crazy（1993）把目录延到 MTV。

lyricQuotes: Dream on / Dream on / Dream until your dreams come true
Walk this way / Talk this way

shortBio.en: Boston Toxic Twins hard-rock; Dream On and Walk This Way as 70s FM pillars, Crazy the MTV ballad return.
shortBio.zh: 波士顿 Toxic Twins hard-rock；Dream On 与 Walk This Way 作 70 年代 FM 支柱，Crazy 是 MTV 谣曲回归。

body.en:
Formed 1970 in Boston. Toys in the Attic (1975) and Rocks (1976) lock Tyler/Perry blues-shout over Whitford/Hamilton/Kramer pocket—Walk This Way’s syncopated riff, Sweet Emotion’s talk-box bass intro. Dream On from the 1973 debut is the piano-to-power-ballad early template.

Perry exits 1979, returns 1984; Permanent Vacation / Pump / Get a Grip (Desmond Child/Diane Warren co-writes, Crazy 1993) rebuild stadium MTV hard-rock. Run-DMC’s 1986 Walk This Way remake cites the riff as hip-hop/hard-rock bridge.
body.zh:
1970 年于波士顿组建。Toys in the Attic（1975）与 Rocks（1976）钉住 Tyler/Perry 蓝调喊叫压 Whitford/Hamilton/Kramer 口袋拍——Walk This Way 切分 riff、Sweet Emotion talk-box 贝斯 intro。1973 年首张的 Dream On 是钢琴到 power ballad 早期模板。

Perry 1979 年离队、1984 年回归；Permanent Vacation / Pump / Get a Grip（Desmond Child/Diane Warren 合写，Crazy 1993）重建体育场 MTV hard-rock。Run-DMC 1986 年 Walk This Way 翻唱把该 riff 钉成 hip-hop/hard-rock 桥。

note.en: Piano ballad to stacked-harmony climax; early power-ballad US FM face.
note.zh: 钢琴谣曲到叠和声高潮；早期 power ballad 美国 FM 面孔。

title.zh: 带 funk 口袋拍的蓝调 hard-rock

body.en:
Aerosmith borrow Stones swagger and Zeppelin volume, then write American riffs with Kramer’s pocket and Perry’s Les Paul bite.

Dream On proves ballad dynamics; Walk This Way proves syncopation sells on FM.

Peak craft is Toys in the Attic / Rocks, not only the 90s video cycle.
body.zh:
Aerosmith 借 Stones 姿态与 Zeppelin 音量，再用 Kramer 口袋拍与 Perry Les Paul 咬合写美国 riff。

Dream On 证明谣曲动态；Walk This Way 证明切分能卖 FM。

巅峰工艺在 Toys in the Attic / Rocks，不只是 90 年代 MV 周期。

body.en:
Tyler/Perry/Whitford/Hamilton/Kramer is the durable core. Perry leaves 1979–1984; Jimmy Crespo covers guitar on Rock in a Hard Place.

Reunion yields Permanent Vacation onward. Writing often splits Tyler/Perry with outside hitmakers in the MTV era.

Stage identity stays Toxic Twins + rhythm section.
body.zh:
Tyler/Perry/Whitford/Hamilton/Kramer 是耐久核心。Perry 1979–1984 离队；Jimmy Crespo 在 Rock in a Hard Place 顶吉他。

重聚后从 Permanent Vacation 起。MTV 期写作常拆 Tyler/Perry 与外部热单写手。

舞台身份仍是 Toxic Twins + 节奏组。

title.zh: 美国 hard-rock 与 hip-hop 桥

body.en:
Guns N' Roses and 80s US hard-rock cite Aerosmith swagger and riff pocket. Run-DMC remake makes Walk This Way a cross-genre teaching track.

Crazy/I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing show the ballad arm of the same band.

Debt is US FM hard-rock grammar, not British metal school.
body.zh:
Guns N' Roses 与 80 年代美国 hard-rock 引用 Aerosmith 姿态与 riff 口袋拍。Run-DMC 翻唱让 Walk This Way 成跨类型教材曲。

Crazy / I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing 展示同一乐队的谣曲臂。

债务在美国 FM hard-rock 语法，非英国金属学派。
